overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated wallet: the single-absolute-scale bar system, before/after account deltas, and proof-forward receipts teach enforceability better than any competitor UI. It is held back by jargon leakage (EntityProvider, collateral tariff, Depository may pull), inconsistent naming for the same secured money, and several layout/truncation defects that clip exactly the trust-critical instructions.
priority_fixes: Standardize the secured-money vocabulary and bar legend across Home/Manage/Account/Sovereignty (one name, labeled segments, matching legend swatches — fix the all-green legend dots on Home)
Replace dense tariff/protocol prose (swap fees, ownership, allowances) with one-line net numbers and progressive disclosure
Fix clipping and truncation of trust-critical text: Sovereignty per-counterparty dispute path, Desk CREDIT OUT column, Pay route hex
Split the cross-network swap into an explicit two-step wizard with an actionable error at the disabled CTA instead of a floating tooltip
Restructure Settings and Assets: guard destructive vault actions at top, demote faucet-collateral widget, give every disabled button a stated reason
